title: Sparkly bell
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bellGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFA500'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E08800'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='sparkGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFFFF'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FFFF88'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFEE44' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Bell handle -->
  <rect x='45' y='14' width='10' height='8' rx='4' fill='#C98A00'/>
  <rect x='43' y='12' width='14' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#FFC233'/>

  <!-- Bell body -->
  <path d='M50 20 C30 20 22 38 22 55 C22 64 26 68 30 70 L70 70 C74 68 78 64 78 55 C78 38 70 20 50 20 Z' fill='url(#bellGrad)'/>
  <!-- Bell highlight -->
  <path d='M42 28 C35 35 32 46 33 56' stroke='#FFEB80' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Bell rim -->
  <rect x='20' y='68' width='60' height='6' rx='3' fill='#D97E00'/>
  <rect x='20' y='68' width='60' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFB833'/>

  <!-- Bell bottom lip -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='32' ry='5' fill='#B86A00'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='30' ry='4' fill='#E89400'/>

  <!-- Clapper -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='6' fill='#B86A00'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='79' r='4' fill='#FFC233'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='77.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFEB80'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Top left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(18,22)'>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='6' fill='url(#sparkGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-6 1.5,-1.5 6,0 1.5,1.5 0,6 -1.5,1.5 -6,0 -1.5,-1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Top right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(82,20)'>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='5' fill='url(#sparkGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-5 1.2,-1.2 5,0 1.2,1.2 0,5 -1.2,1.2 -5,0 -1.2,-1.2' fill='#FFFFCC'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(10,50)'>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='4' fill='url(#sparkGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-4 1,-1 4,0 1,1 0,4 -1,1 -4,0 -1,-1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(90,48)'>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='4.5' fill='url(#sparkGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-4.5 1.1,-1.1 4.5,0 1.1,1.1 0,4.5 -1.1,1.1 -4.5,0 -1.1,-1.1' fill='#FFFFDD'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Bottom left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(24,84)'>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='3.5' fill='url(#sparkGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-3.5 0.9,-0.9 3.5,0 0.9,0.9 0,3.5 -0.9,0.9 -3.5,0 -0.9,-0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Bottom right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(76,86)'>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='4' fill='url(#sparkGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-4 1,-1 4,0 1,1 0,4 -1,1 -4,0 -1,-1' fill='#FFFFCC'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small top sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(50,6)'>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='3' fill='url(#sparkGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-3 0.8,-0.8 3,0 0.8,0.8 0,3 -0.8,0.8 -3,0 -0.8,-0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Tiny sparkle accents -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='36' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8CC'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8CC'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='90' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8CC'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='14' r='1.2' fill='#FFF8CC'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='62' r='1.2' fill='#FFF8CC'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='64' r='1.2' fill='#FFF8CC'/>
</svg>
